levels.name: 'Eternal Hunt'
levels.description:
Immediately marks a target within range, Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>lengthens significantly</>, and attacks become a hail of arrows aimed at the marked target; the hail of arrows will randomly strike enemies around the marked target, dealing <@ba.vup>{attack@s3_max_hit_num}</> hits of <@ba.vup>{attack@s3_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and stunning targets hit for <@ba.vup>{attack@s3_stun}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {attack@s3_trigger_time} ammo and the skill ends when all ammo is used (Can manually deactivate skill)</>

runtimeMapping.normal: Heaviest eligible ground/air victim; original facing Begin/Loop event with capped animation playback; speed-12 native arrow.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected rank ATK/ASPD and 35-second duration; normal facing attacks and both selected talents.
runtimeMapping.s2: Two speed-10 arrows per cast; short first-shot flag supplies secondary preference with sole-victim fallback; independent selected stun rolls. First use finite, second and later uses permanent per deployment with original stance clips.
runtimeMapping.s3: Original fixed-time Aim begin and 1.05-second attack lock; moving radius-1.3 mark pulses at native .2-second interval with .21-second flags. Own flags acquire attacks, all sources flag rain selection. No rain collider: random periodic selector, selected hit cap, .7-second lifetime, .23-second retained target-buff delay. One ammo per volley; final completion reserves selection lifetime plus delayed impact.
runtimeMapping.penetration: Selected promotion stack increment and cap at each Typhon damage calculation before mitigation; reset after selected idle timeout.
runtimeMapping.firstHit: Selected promotion/potential first-victim multiplier per activation; derived owned Sluggish and victim set clear with skill, retirement or death. Shared Sluggish reducer prevents compounding.
runtimeMapping.animation: Delivered original Front/Back skeleton byte identity, hit events and Begin/Loop/End roles. UP uses Back; other facings use Front with Down-specific roles where present.

verificationLimits: Compiled native Aim/continuous-attack FSM and final-ammo completion require game-frame comparison. The adapter reserves .7-second selection lifetime plus .23-second target-buff delay before ending final ammo.
Native random-selector RNG stream, callback priority and same-frame ordering are not recovered. Local selectors sample each eligible pulse; attacks run on the shared 30 Hz simulation clock.

Target-owned non-missable rain finishes against its retained living/deployed recipient after concealment. Shared invulnerability/dodge/shield/status ordering remains a local mapping, not executable native dispatcher recovery.

Talent damage-calculation attribution after withdrawal, source stat rebasing during delayed damage, animation interruption/transition blending and abnormal-state timing remain unverified against the game.
Native Unity particles, sound, module upgrades, stage scenery and physical-device touch are not verified by this operator implementation.
